description_en: Queries the list of egress proxy configurations
name: ListEgressProxyConfigurations

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page during paging in a paged query. Valid values: 0 to 1000. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数。取值范围：0~1000。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

Leave this parameter empty for the first query or when no next query is required.
If a next query is required, set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned from the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to skip during paging in a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时跳过的条目数。取值需大于等于 0。默认值：0
parameters.name: skip

parameters.help_en: The list of egress proxy configuration IDs
parameters.help_zh: 出口配置 ID 列表
parameters.name: egress_proxy_configuration_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of egress proxy configuration names
parameters.name: egress_proxy_configuration_names

parameters.help_en:
Filters egress proxy configurations by status. Valid values:

Provisioning: The egress proxy configuration is being created.

Available: The egress proxy configuration is available.

Configuring: The specifications of the egress proxy configuration are being changed
parameters.help_zh:
按出口配置状态过滤。取值：

Provisioning：创建中。

Available：可用。

Configuring：变配中
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

EgressProxyConfigurations.description_en: The list of egress proxy configurations

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the egress proxy configuration was created. The time is displayed in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreateTime.description_zh: 出口配置的创建时间。采用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Description.description_en: The description of the egress proxy configuration. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_)
Description.description_zh: 出口配置的描述信息。长度为 2~256 个字符，可包含中文、字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）

EgressProxyConfigurationId.description_en: The ID of the egress proxy configuration

EgressProxyConfigurationName.description_en: The name of the egress proxy configuration. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
EgressProxyConfigurationName.description_zh: 出口配置的名称。长度为 2~128 个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

Status.description_en:
The status of the egress proxy configuration. Valid values:

Provisioning: The egress proxy configuration is being created.

Available: The egress proxy configuration is available.

Configuring: The specifications of the egress proxy configuration are being changed
Status.description_zh:
出口配置的状态。取值：

Provisioning：创建中。

Available：可用。

Configuring：变配中

Key.description_en: The tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
Key.description_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`

Value.description_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
Value.description_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned for the current request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next query is required.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果 NextToken 为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果 NextToken 有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of egress proxy configurations that meet the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的出口配置总条目数
